entities.name: Mytaru
entities.description: Minotaur of the Urhaalan clan in Dominaria's Dark Age who sacrificed himself in the Living Armor.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: Human boy adopted by the clan, Mytaru's blood-brother, wearer of the Living Armor.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: Manipulated the minotaurs into war with the elves, using coal golems.

entities.name: Tiyint
entities.description: Stone avatar of a legendary Urhaalan hero that turned on its creators.

entities.name: Living Armor
entities.description: Armor Yunnie wore, whose magic rebounds damage.

entities.name: Pardano
entities.description: Son of Aesor, killed in a cave-in.

events.quote: eventually became blood-brothers during a ceremony

events.summary: Mytaru, misled by Sacumon, helps instigate war against the elves.
events.quote: Mytaru became one of the instigators of the war

events.summary: Mytaru disowns Yunnie and has him expelled from the clan.
events.quote: an enraged Mytaru disowned his new blood-brother and had him expelled from his clan

events.summary: Mytaru awakens the stone avatar of Tiyint, which slaughters elves, then turns on the Urhaalan.
events.quote: the giant stone minotaur turned on its creators, killing many of the Urhaalan

events.summary: Pardano is killed in a cave-in caused by Tiyint's earthquakes.
events.quote: Pardano , son of Aesor , was killed in a cave-in caused by one of these earthquakes.

events.summary: Mytaru dons the Living Armor and is crushed by Tiyint, draining Tiyint's life force.
events.quote: Tiyint grabbed Mytaru and squeezed him in his hand

relations.quote: Mytaru was a minotaur of the Urhaalan clan
eventually became blood-brothers during a ceremony

relations.note: used coal golems to wipe out minotaur villages
relations.quote: Sacumon continued to use her coal golems to wipe out entire minotaur villages
even as it crushed Mytaru to death
